provenance.working_tree_clean_at_build: yes (dataset rebuilt before 87cb88d, code committed unchanged from the working-tree state that produced this exact output)

source_frozen_commits.hrrr_rh: additive pilot-scope-only backfill, see data/processed/pilot/hrrr_rh/manifest.json (added by this fix, 2026-09-29)

provenance.notes: Built entirely from already-frozen, already-manifested source outputs plus the new additive HRRR RH backfill -- no existing source extraction was modified during this phase. Fully reproducible via: python scripts/build_integrated_pilot.py (then python scripts/audit_integrated_pilot.py, python scripts/test_integration.py). Supersedes commit d3325d2: the 2026-09-29 pipeline-survival fix closed the gap found by the pre-backfill variable inventory audit (f972424) -- only instantaneous temperature had been threaded through to the integrated dataset; dewpoint/wind/pressure/cloud/precipitation/radiation/native-period-Tmax-Tmin and GEFS member-level trajectories are now preserved via two new additive tables (atmospheric_trajectories.parquet, gefs_member_trajectories.parquet), without modifying the existing protected temperature-only pipeline. See docs/integrated_pilot_validation.md's 'Pipeline-survival fix (2026-09-29)' section for full details. All 480 states were rebuilt from frozen sources after the fix (row/column counts of all pre-existing outputs are identical to the pre-fix build, confirming the fix is purely additive).

target.label_definition: Realized Central Park/KNYC daily maximum temperature (ISD observations, is_real_observation=True rows only). KLGA/KJFK/KEWR are auxiliary predictors only, never averaged into the target. Kalshi settlement-station reconciliation is explicitly out of scope for this dataset.

query_time_schedule.timezone: America/New_York (DST-correct via zoneinfo, no hardcoded UTC offset)

state_construction.core_rule: ATOMIC WITHIN SOURCE, ASYNCHRONOUS ACROSS SOURCES -- see docs/live_information_state.md
state_construction.eligibility_rule: available_time <= query_time (never run_time or valid_time) for every S3_LAST_MODIFIED_PROXY source; observation_time / issuance_time as documented proxies, PROXY mode only
state_construction.integration_fix: get_latest_forecast/get_ensemble_state/get_observation_state/get_target_day_progress gained a backward-compatible optional target_date parameter (previously hardcoded to the single feasibility-test-era date 2025-07-01)

B_structured_features.purpose: model-friendly scalar features (now includes {source}_usable_since per numerical source)

forecast_trajectories.note: instantaneous temperature only (TMP/2t) per source -- previously 218686 rows before the variable-mixing fix, which had silently included DPT and period-max/min products. PROTECTED: unchanged by the 2026-09-29 pipeline-survival fix (row count identical).

gefs_members.note: per-member daily-max scalar, unchanged by the 2026-09-29 pipeline-survival fix

atmospheric_trajectories.note: HRRR/GFS/NBM/ECMWF deterministic, every non-temperature variable family, normalized long format (state_id/source/variable/run_time/valid_time/forecast_hour/value/units/temporal_stat/temporal_window_hours)

gefs_member_trajectories.note: GEFS, ALL variables including TMP, full per-member granularity (31/31 members every usable state) -- mean/median/std/quantiles/disagreement/revision are all derivable downstream without re-downloading

label_methodology.computation: max(temperature_f) over all is_real_observation=True KNYC rows within the NYC-local target day, independent of query_time
label_methodology.hard_constraint: KNYC_tmax_so_far_f (a feature) can never exceed label_tmax_f (the label) -- verified 0 violations across all 480 states

source_availability_methodologies.gefs: S3_LAST_MODIFIED_PROXY, NORMAL confidence, per-member/per-FH granularity preserved
source_availability_methodologies.ecmwf_deterministic: S3_LAST_MODIFIED_PROXY, LOW confidence (bulk archive-sync event, not genuine per-forecast-hour dissemination -- see docs/ecmwf_pilot_readiness.md)

known_limitations: ECMWF ensemble, AIFS, and additional numerical-weather providers are out of scope
This is a 40-day methodology-validation prototype, not the final multi-year training dataset
AFD availability in this sample (100% under PROXY) should not be assumed at true backfill scale (irregular issuance cadence)

data/weather_state.py's get_observation_state/get_afd_state internal provenance.source_file fields still reference the original single-day feasibility-test paths (cosmetic only; state_index.parquet is the authoritative provenance record)

This 40-day production run's target-day-only design never reaches ECMWF forecast hours beyond F144, so the mx2t3-to-mx2t6 regime transition (validated separately in the ECMWF pilot phase) is not exercised in this specific dataset
reproducibility_command: python scripts/build_integrated_pilot.py && python scripts/audit_integrated_pilot.py && python scripts/test_integration.py
